capabilities: Convert Markdown to Confluence Storage Format (XHTML)
Convert Markdown to legacy Confluence Wiki Markup
Copy converted output to the clipboard
Preserve headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and Obsidian embeds
Configure image widths, code block themes, line numbers, and collapsing
extras: Conversion happens locally to the clipboard; the plugin does not upload or sync to Confluence directly. Includes a Jest test suite with sample Markdown and Confluence markup files.
problem: Obsidian cannot produce Confluence-compatible markup, so users must manually rewrite formatting when moving notes into Confluence.

relations.evidence: This plugin includes code adapted from markdown-to-confluence-vscode and updated to be compatible with marked version 15.0.4.

summary: Markdown-to-Confluence converter that copies notes as Confluence Storage Format (XHTML) or Wiki Markup to the clipboard for pasting.
